{"id":1942874093,"question_id":3388,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1773062675,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"23 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1942874093/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Right Triangles","memory":"114.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long numberOfRightTriangles(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {\n        int n = grid.size();\n        int m = grid[0].size();\n\n        vector<int>rows(n , 0) , cols(m , 0);\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m; j++)\n            {\n                if(grid[i][j] == 1)\n                {\n                    rows[i]++;\n                    cols[j]++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        long long ans = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m; j++)\n            {\n                if(grid[i][j] == 1)\n                {\n                    ans += (rows[i] - 1) * (cols[j] - 1);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"right-triangles","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1822}
